title: Epoch Residential
description: Epoch Residential (Epoch Management, Inc.) — US private multifamily real estate developer, builder and property manager, Winter Park, Florida. Founded 1970. Vertically integrated: land acquisition, development, construction, asset and property management, investor relations. Builds Class-A garden, mid-rise and townhome communities plus active-adult (55+) housing across Sunbelt and Southeast suburbs. ~39,000 units in 155+ communities delivered; 100,000+ managed.Once the timer expires, the files will be available for sale — submit your request to the operator. http://epochresidential.com/
